text: Adriana's Insurance, the California insurance agency on the right sleeve of San Diego FC jerseys, is part of the AGI Business Group, which founder Adriana Gallardo's own biography says she owns.
short: Adriana's Insurance is part of AGI Business Group, owned by founder Adriana Gallardo.

source.name: adrianagallardo.com – 'Biography - Adriana Gallardo'
source.quote: She currently owns the AGI Business Group empire, which includes Adriana's Insurance, the leading auto insurance agency in Southern California.
